source_review.finding: Complete positive writes advance exactly by valid integer progress; InterruptedError retries; zero, negative, bool, noninteger, or overlarge results raise. Empty input performs no write.
Inherited soft RLIMIT_FSIZE applies to total final size, including append offset; equality and infinity are accepted, overflow rejected.

Serialization and inherited-size refusal precede filesystem effects. Writes complete into a private temporary file, exact st_size is checked, the temporary file is fsynced and closed before replacement, and the parent directory is fsynced afterwards. Tested pre-replacement failures preserve original bytes, inode, mtime and mode and remove temporary artifacts. A post-rename directory-fsync failure propagates despite complete new bytes; no durable success is claimed.

Serialization precedes opening. O_NOFOLLOW and exclusive flock guard the append; existing file length is included in the inherited bound; successful short/EINTR progress writes a full event and fsyncs. Total-size refusal preserves existing history. Write and fsync failures remain failures.

Default write=True remains functional and persists updates. write=False validates the existing owned private directory with lstat, requires an existing registry and lock, opens the lock O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, takes the same exclusive flock, and never timestamps or rewrites the registry. Missing paths, unsafe ownership/mode, directory symlinks and lock symlinks fail without creation.

Uses write=False and tests register_peer only on a JSON deep copy. Exact actual pure-core AST functions were used for 25 absent/ACTIVE/RESULT_READY/CLOSED/CANCELLED/PAUSED and idempotent-terminal transitions. All preserved persistent bytes, inode, mtime, mode and original updated_at.
